result.title: Spectral Limits of Polynomial Graph Filters on the Long-Range Ising Model Benchmark
result.summary: The Long-Range Ising Model benchmark (LRIM) guarantees long-range dependence by construction: each label is the node's spin times the spin field convolved with a power-law coupling, so any model's distance from the target is measurable. We prove that a readout whose filter is a polynomial in the adjacency, the linear core of isotropic message passing and spectral graph networks, leaves an error floor that no degree lowers, because the target varies along a level set of the spectrum on which every such filter is constant. Computed exactly, the floor and the best filter of each degree predict two spectral networks adapted from published architectures to within a tenth of a decade. A filter escapes the floor only if it weighs separately the offsets the adjacency lumps together, and must still resolve the coupling across the whole lattice. A strided filter of about fifty coefficients does both: fitted to the training labels, its test error is 52 times below the best published network's. A dilated convolutional network beats the best published result at 256 nodes, matches it at 1,024, and gives the first in-domain results at the three larger sizes, while a Fourier neural operator with its standard modes falls further behind as the lattice grows. At its standard budget the dilated network stays two to four orders of magnitude short of a larger strided filter fitted to the labels. The analysis carries over to the benchmark's second coupling.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 Long-Range Ising Model 图基准上证明：以邻接多项式为核心的谱图网络存在无法靠提高阶数消除的误差下限，因目标信号在谱水平集上变化而该类滤波器在其上恒定；并给出约五十系数的 strided filter 与 dilated 卷积网络突破该下限。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「滤波器对称性导致信息在谱水平集上坍缩、必须单独区分偏移量」的不可达性分析，与 LVR 关注的内部状态是否保留位置与长程依赖等任务必要信息可能相通，可供核查，但任务与模态相距较远。
